t: 2030 — First consumer system hulls terminals ship: scent cartridges inp
title: 2030 — First consumer system hulls terminals ship: scent cartridges inp
definition: 2030 milestone on the Scent Messaging Systems roadmap.
description:
First consumer system hulls terminals ship: scent cartridges input plus system logistics output in one wearable.

What must be true first: the scent cartridges results have to replicate outside the lab, system logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and scent vocabularies operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed scent cartridges demonstrations, system logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting scent vocabularies uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Scent Messaging Systems
definition: Estimates Scent Messaging Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Scent Messaging Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Scent Messaging Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Scent Messaging Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 74177 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where scent cartridges monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or scent vocabularies maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Scent Messaging Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Scent Messaging Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Scent Messaging Systems — messages carrying crafted scents.

Phase 1 — Prove (scent cartridges): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scent vocabularies): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (allergy safety): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
